data.narrative:
Zeitview is a Series D autonomous systems company founded by Dan Burton that has raised $174M to date. The valuation universe comprises 8 private peers in Drones & Autonomous, including Wayve, Waymo, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow sector.

A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage data points within Drones & Autonomous—only 1 same-stage peer was identified, below the 3-datapoint threshold for reliable triangulation. The stage-progression method was therefore applied as the primary valuation vector, using total raised ($174M) as a proxy base and applying a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement, yielding $261M.

The triangulated valuation range is $222M (low) to $300M (high), with a median of $261M supported by the stage-progression method. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-set peer data to validate cross-sectional positioning within the autonomous sector and the reliance on a single methodology. This range reflects reasonable step-up assumptions for the stage but should be stress-tested against specific operational metrics—revenue run rate, unit economics, or capital efficiency—once available to ground the analysis in fundamental performance data rather than stage-based progression alone.
